blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: The performance of medical image segmentation depends on a large amount of annotated data, and most segmentation models experience a significant drop in performance in low-sample-size scenarios. Existing semi-supervised and weakly supervised methods rely on specific network architectures, while traditional multi-view-assisted segmentation methods require strictly paired samples, which limits their clinical applications. To address these issues, we propose DPIF, a general-purpose plug-and-play dual-path interaction framework compatible with arbitrary encoder-decoder segmentation networks, which leverages cross-view anatomical complementarity to reduce annotation reliance. DPIF first performs Sinkhorn optimal transport-based cross-view distribution alignment to establish global semantic correspondence without sample-level pairing. It then adopts conditional mutual information-guided feature decoupling to enable bidirectional knowledge transfer only within the shared semantic space, suppressing view-specific noise. Finally, persistent homology-based topological regularization encodes anatomical invariants as unsupervised priors to mitigate overfitting. Experiments were conducted using 24 baseline models on a private multicenter echocardiography dataset and two public datasets. The results show that DPIF-enhanced models outperform single-view baseline models when trained on comparable amounts of data. Notably, most dual-path variants trained on 40\% - 60\% of the data achieve performance comparable to that of single-view models trained on the full dataset. This demonstrates that DPIF provides a general-purpose and scalable solution for data-scarce multi-view medical image segmentation problems.
blocks.zh: 医学影像分解的性能取决于大量附加说明的数据,大多数分解模型在低样本大小的假想中,性能显著下降. 现有的半监督制和弱监督制的方法依赖于特定的网络架构,而传统的多景辅助分化方法则需要严格的配对样本,这限制了它们的临床应用. 为了解决这些问题,我们提议DPIF,一个通用的插件和游戏双路径交互框架,兼容任意的编码器-解码器分割网络,它利用跨视图解剖互补来减少对注释的依赖. DPIF首先进行Sinkhorn最优的基于传输的交叉视图分布对齐,在不进行样本级对齐的情况下建立全球语义对应. 然后采用有条件的相互信息引导特征脱钩,使双向知识只在共享语义空间内进行转移,抑制特定视图噪声. 最后,持续的基于同义的地形规范化将解剖学的不变量编码为无监督的前科,以减轻过度适应. 利用24个基准模型对一个私人多中心回声心学数据集和两个公共数据集进行了实验。 结果显示,DPIF增强模型在接受可比数据量培训时,优于单景基线模型. 值得注意的是,接受过40++-60+++数据培训的大多数双向变体的性能与接受过完整数据集培训的单视模型的性能相当。 这表明DPIF为数据稀缺的多视图医学图像分解问题提供了一个通用和可伸缩的解决方案.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Accurate medical image segmentation is the foundation for clinical quantitative analysis, disease diagnosis, and surgical planning. Although deep learning has advanced this field, its performance still depends on large-scale datasets with pixel-level annotations Gan et al. (2025) . Unlike natural images, annotating medical images requires specialized clinical knowledge, making the process both time-consuming and costly. For multi-view imaging protocols, each view must be annotated separately, leading to a significant increase in workload and costs. Therefore, the scarcity of annotated data remains a major bottleneck for clinical translation, particularly for rare diseases Dissanayake et al. (2025) .
blocks.zh: 准确的医学影像分割是临床定量分析,疾病诊断,手术规划的基础. 虽然深度学习已经推进了这个领域,但其性能仍然依赖于具有像素级说明的大型数据集Gan et al. (2025). 与自然图像不同,对医疗图像进行注释需要专门的临床知识,使这一过程既费时又费钱. 对于多视图成像协议,每个视图必须分别附加注释,导致工作量和成本的大幅增加. 因此,缺乏附加说明的数据仍然是临床翻译的一个主要瓶颈,尤其是对罕见疾病Dissanayake等人(2025年)而言。

blocks.en: In standard clinical practice, images of the same anatomical structure are typically acquired from multiple angles to enable a comprehensive assessment of lesions Berahmand et al. (2025) . For example, a standard echocardiogram simultaneously acquires both the long-axis and short-axis views of the left ventricle. Although these views contain highly complementary anatomical information, they differ significantly in terms of geometric structure and imaging characteristics Du et al. (2026) . Current mainstream segmentation methods still process each view independently, failing to fully leverage the inherent structural and semantic relationships between views. Most existing multi-view fusion methods employ simple strategies Liu et al. (2024b) ; Majerník et al. (2026) . These methods overlook the substantial spatial structural differences and variations in semantic distribution across views, often introducing redundant noise and yielding only limited performance improvements. More critically, most multi-view frameworks are tightly coupled with specific backbone architectures, which hinders their rapid adaptation to new tasks and poses challenges for cross-scenario deployment Zhou et al. (2026) .
blocks.zh: 在标准临床实践中,通常从多个角度获取相同解剖结构的图像,以便能够全面评估损伤情况(2025年)。 例如,标准的回声心电图同时获得左侧通风口的长轴和短轴视图. 虽然这些观点包含高度互补的解剖学信息,但在几何结构和成像特征Du等人(2026年)上差异很大. 目前的主流分解方法仍然独立处理每个观点,未能充分利用观点之间的内在结构和语义关系. 大多数现有的多视聚变方法都采用了简单的策略Liu等人(2024b);Majerník等人(2026). 这些方法忽略了各种观点在语义上的巨大空间结构差异和差异,往往引入了多余的噪音,并且只能产生有限的性能改进. 更为关键的是,大多数多景框架与具体的骨干结构紧密结合,这阻碍了它们迅速适应新的任务,并对交叉情景部署周等人(2026年)构成挑战.

blocks.en: To address these fundamental limitations, we propose a general-purpose dual-path interaction framework. Its core idea is to leverage the complementarity of cross-view anatomical structures as an alternative to expanding the annotated dataset. The framework features a universal, plug-and-play design that is compatible with various segmentation backbone models and achieves high-precision segmentation with only a small number of annotated samples. The main contributions of this study are summarized as follows:
blocks.zh: 为了解决这些根本的局限性,我们提出了一个通用的双向互动框架。 其核心思想是利用跨视解剖结构的互补性,作为扩大注释数据集的替代. 框架的特点是通用的,插座式的和游戏式的设计,与各种分块主干模型兼容,并且只有少量附加说明的样本实现高精度分块. 这项研究的主要贡献总结如下:

blocks.en:
We propose a general-purpose dual-path interaction framework designed to reduce reliance on segmented annotated data. This framework can be integrated into any encoder-decoder Segmentation network.
We propose a cross-view alignment mechanism based on optimal transport theory. It establishes semantic correspondences by minimizing the Wasserstein distance, thereby enabling distribution-level alignment of unpaired data.
We propose a two-layer decoupling strategy for cross-view knowledge transfer. Under conditional mutual information constraints, features are decomposed into shared and view-specific components, and knowledge transfer and enhancement are performed only in the shared space to suppress noise propagation.
We propose a regularization method based on cross-view topological consistency. This method uses anatomical topological invariants as shared prior information to impose constraints, thereby narrowing the hypothesis space and mitigating the problem of overfitting in small-sample settings.
blocks.zh:
我们建议建立一个通用双向互动框架,以减少对部分附加说明数据的依赖。 这个框架可以被集成到任何编码器-解码器分割网络中.
我们提出一个基于优化运输理论的交叉视野对接机制. 它通过将瓦瑟斯坦的距离最小化来建立语义对应,从而能够使未发报的数据在分布级别上一致.
我们提出一个双层脱钩战略,用于交叉视野的知识转让. 在有条件的相互信息限制下,特征被分解成共享和特定视图的组成部分,知识的转让和增强只在共享空间进行,以抑制噪音传播。
我们提出一种基于交叉视角地形一致性的规范化方法. 这种方法使用解剖学的地形变异剂作为共享的前置信息来施加限制,从而缩小假说空间,减轻小样本环境中的过度配位问题.

blocks.en: 2 Related WORK
blocks.zh: 2. 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Multi-view Medical Image Segmentation
blocks.zh: 2.1 多视图医疗图像分割

blocks.en: Existing multi-view medical image segmentation methods can be broadly categorized into three paradigms: input-level, feature-level, and decision-level fusion. Input-level fusion stacks multi-view images as multi-channel inputs but ignores spatial differences between views. Feature-level fusion directly concatenates or superimposes intermediate features within the network, but carries the risk of introducing view-specific noise and artifacts Wang and Voiculescu (2022) . Decision-level fusion, while capable of merging independent prediction outputs, discards complementary semantic information present in the hidden layers Li et al. (2025) . Although improvements based on attention mechanisms have shown some promise, most fusion schemes remain constrained by their network architectures, making it difficult to transfer them across different segmentation pipelines Zhan et al. (2023) . Furthermore, most of these schemes are designed for fully annotated datasets and perform poorly when data is limited. Crucially, nearly all existing methods require strictly paired multi-view patient data, which imposes severe constraints on real-world clinical inputs.
blocks.zh: 现有的多视图医学影像分解方法可以大致分为三个范式:输入级,特征级,决策级聚变. 输入级聚变堆栈多视图图像作为多通道输入,但忽略了观点之间的空间差异. 地物级聚变直接凝聚或叠加网络内部的中间特征,但承担着引入特定景色噪声和文物王和Voiculescu(2022)的风险. 决策层聚变虽然能够合并独立的预测输出,但丢弃隐藏层Li等人(2025年)中存在的互补语义信息. 虽然基于关注机制的改进显示出一些希望,但大多数聚变计划仍然受到其网络结构的限制,因此很难通过不同的分化管道进行转移 詹等 (2023) (中文(简体) ). 此外,这些计划大多是为附加充分说明的数据集设计的,在数据有限时表现不佳。 关键是,几乎所有现有的方法都要求严格配对的多景病人数据,这对现实世界的临床投入造成了严重的制约.

blocks.en: 2.2 Small-Sample Medical Image Segmentation
blocks.zh: 2.2 小样本医疗图像分解

blocks.en: To address the issue of scarce annotations, existing research primarily follows three approaches: semi-supervised learning, weakly supervised learning, and few-shot learning. Semi-supervised methods utilize large amounts of unlabeled data to aid training, but still rely on a certain scale of unlabeled data, thus imposing requirements on the data volume Cao et al. (2025) . Weakly supervised methods employ weak labels, such as point annotations and bounding box annotations, to reduce annotation costs. However, due to the limitations imposed by the simplicity of these labels, there is an upper bound on accuracy. Chen et al. (2025a) Few-shot learning methods aim to achieve generalization with small datasets through cross-domain knowledge transfer. However, due to significant variations across medical imaging domains, their practical effectiveness remains uncertain Dissanayake et al. (2025) . It is worth noting that existing methods rarely exploit the inherent correlations among multi-view images of the same object, nor have they established a universal interaction scheme that can be reused across models. Meanwhile, the cost of acquiring multi-view images in clinical settings is far lower than the cost of annotating data required for a single view, and this potential has yet to be fully utilized.
blocks.zh: 为了解决紧缺说明的问题,现有的研究主要遵循三种方法:半监督学习,监督学习不力,短镜头学习. 半监督方法利用大量无标签数据协助培训,但仍依赖一定规模的无标签数据,从而对数据量Cao等人(2025年)提出了要求. 受弱监督的方法使用弱标签,如点标注和边框标注,以减少注释成本. 然而,由于这些标签的简单性所施加的限制,对准确性有上限. 陈等人(2025a) 很少的速成学习方法旨在通过跨域知识转移实现小数据集的概括化. 然而,由于医学成像领域的差异很大,其实际效力仍不确定Dissanayake等人(2025年)。 值得注意的是,现有方法很少利用同一物体的多视图图像之间的内在关联,也没有建立可跨模型重复使用的通用互动机制. 同时,在临床环境中获取多视图图像的成本远远低于单一视图所需的注释数据成本,这一潜力尚未得到充分利用。

blocks.en: 3.1 Overview
blocks.zh: 3.1 概览

blocks.en: As shown in Fig 1 , our proposed Dual-Path Interaction Framework (DPIF) adopts a symmetric dual-branch architecture, in which the backbone networks share the same structure but are initialized independently. Each branch receives a single-view image for segmenting the target anatomical structure. The training process is divided into three stages. In the feature encoding stage, a dual-branch encoder extracts multiscale features. Subsequently, the ODI module is invoked at designated encoder-decoder layers to perform feature decoupling, unpaired distribution alignment, and adaptive bidirectional feature enhancement, after which the enhanced features are fed back to the decoder. Meanwhile, a topological regularization loss serves as an anatomical prior to ensure topological consistency across different views. In the final decoding and joint training stage, each decoder upsamples and aggregates the features to generate segmentation outputs and soft probability maps. The entire framework is optimized via a composite loss function. During the inference stage, the interaction module is disabled, and the two branches operate independently.
blocks.zh: 如图1所示,我们提议的双帕互动框架采用了对称的双分支结构,骨干网络在其中共享相同的结构,但独立初始化。 每个分支都得到一个单视图图像,用于分割目标解剖结构. 培训过程分为三个阶段。 在特征编码阶段,双分支编码器会提取多尺度特性. 随后,ODI模块在指定的编码器-解码器层中被引用,以进行特征解码,无保配配对,以及适应性的双向特性增强,之后增强的特性反馈到解码器. 同时,在确保不同观点的地形一致性之前,地形正规化损失是一种解剖学。 在最终解码和联合培训阶段,每个解码器上标并汇总特征生成分解输出和软概率图. 整个框架通过复合损失函数进行优化. 在推论阶段,交互模块被禁用,两个分支独立运行.

blocks.en: 3.2.3 Adaptive Interaction Weights Based on Segmentation Uncertainty
blocks.zh: 3.2.3 基于分裂的适应性相互作用重量

blocks.en: In clinical practice, there are inherent differences in imaging quality and segmentation difficulty across different views. Fixed, symmetric interaction cannot adapt to such differences, often resulting in underutilization of high-quality information while allowing low-quality information to cause excessive interference. To address this issue, we designed an energy function based on segmentation uncertainty to dynamically adjust the intensity of bidirectional interaction, thereby enabling the directed transmission of high-confidence features to the low-confidence branch.
blocks.zh: 在临床实践中,不同观点在成像质量和分化难度上存在固有的差异. 固定的,对称的相互作用无法适应这种差异,往往导致对高质量信息的利用不足,同时允许低质量的信息造成过度干扰. 为了解决这个问题,我们设计了一个基于分化不确定性的能量函数,以动态地调整双向相互作用的强度,从而能够将高自信特征直接传递给低自信分支.

blocks.en: First, we calculate the segmentation uncertainty for each view based on its predicted map:
blocks.zh: 首先,我们根据其预测的地图计算每个视图的分解不确定性:

blocks.en: E = − 1 N ∑ i = 1 N ( p i log p i + ( 1 − p i ) log ( 1 − p i ) ) E=-\frac{1}{N}\sum_{i=1}^{N}\left(p_{i}\log p_{i}+(1-p_{i})\log(1-p_{i})\right) (4)
Here, p i p_{i} is the predicted probability that pixel i belongs to the target region, and E ∈ [ 0 , 1 ] E\in[0,1] . A higher value indicates greater segmentation uncertainty and lower confidence.
blocks.zh: 这里,p i p_{i}是预测的像素i属于目标区域的概率,而E ∈ [0, 1] E\ in [0, 1]. 较高的价值表明分化不确定性更大,信心较低。

blocks.en: Based on the difference in uncertainty between the two branches, adaptive interaction weights are generated using the sigmoid function:

where α 0 \alpha_{0} is the base interaction strength, and τ \tau is the temperature coefficient that controls the smoothness of weight adjustments. When the confidence in the long-axis segmentation is significantly lower than that of the short-axis segmentation, α l \alpha_{l} increases, causing the long-axis branch to receive more guidance from the short-axis branch, the opposite is also true.

blocks.en: 3.3 Cross-View Topological Consistency Regularization Loss
blocks.zh: 3.3 跨视频地形一致性规范化损失

blocks.en:
In small-sample scenarios, limited training coverage may induce spurious pixel-level correlations and produce unreasonable segmentation results, while pixel-based loss functions struggle to mitigate this phenomenon. We consider that anatomical structures possess inherent topological invariance, and that key topological statistics across multi-view projections exhibit high consistency, which can serve as unsupervised priors to narrow the model’s hypothesis space and alleviate overfitting. Therefore, drawing inspiration from persistent homology-based topological data analysis methods, we propose a cross-view topological consistency regularization loss Kapulkin and Kershaw (2026) .
Starting from the segmentation probability map of each view, we obtain a persistent diagram (PD) through sub-level set filtering, where the points encode topological features characterized by thresholds and corresponding persistent values. Higher persistence values indicate more stable and anatomically plausible structures. Since the exact persistence homology calculation is non-differentiable, we employ a differentiable approximation method: applying multiscale Gaussian smoothing to the probability graph to obtain an approximate persistence graph. The second-order Wasserstein distance between the persistence graphs of the two views forms our topological loss function:

在小样假想中,有限的培训覆盖面可能诱发虚假的像素水平关联,并产生不合理的分化结果,而基于像素的丢失函数则为缓解这一现象而挣扎. 我们认为解剖结构具有内在的地形偏差,跨多视角预测的关键地形统计显示出高度的一致性,这可以作为无监督的前科,缩小模型的假说空间,缓解过度适应。 因此,我们从持续的基于同位素的地形数据分析方法中汲取灵感,提出交叉视图的地形一致性规范化损失Kapulkin和Kershaw(2026年).
从每个视图的分割概率图开始,我们通过子级集过滤获得一个持续图(PD),其中点编码地形特征,特征是阈值和相应的持续值. 较高的持久性值表明,从解剖学上看,结构更加稳定。 由于精确的持久性同位素计算是不可区分的,所以我们采用不同的近似法:将多尺度高斯平滑法应用到概率图上,以获得近似持久性图. 两种观点的持久性图之间的二阶瓦瑟斯坦距离构成了我们的地形损失函数:

blocks.en: 4.1 Datasets
blocks.zh: 4.1 数据集

blocks.en: We conducted our evaluation using three multi-view medical imaging datasets, including a private multicenter echocardiography dataset (referred to as PME), the publicly available FLARE2023 liver CT dataset, and the MSD hippocampal MRI dataset. The specific datasets used are shown in Fig 2 .
blocks.zh: 我们利用三个多视图医学成像数据集进行了评估,包括一个私人多中心回声心电图数据集(称为PME),一个公开的FLARE2023肝脏CT数据集,以及MSD hipocampal核磁共振数据集。 使用的具体数据集见图2。

blocks.en: PME Dataset: This dataset compiles data from 429 patients across five clinical centers, providing images of the apical four-chamber long-axis view and the papillary muscle-level short-axis view, along with annotations of the left ventricular myocardium. One image at the end of systole and one at the end of diastole are selected for each cardiac cycle, resulting in 858 images per view.
blocks.zh: PME 主题 数据集 : 这个数据集汇编了来自5个临床中心429位患者的数据,提供了阿皮卡四室长轴视图和帕比勒肌肉水平短轴视图的图像,以及左心肌的注释. 每个心脏周期都选取一个Systole端的图像和一个diastole端的图像,结果每个视图的图像为858张.

blocks.en: FLARE2023 Dataset Ma et al. (2024) : 2D slices with liver annotations from two views were extracted from the 3D abdominal CT volumes. After filtering based on liver size and the presence of tumors, 581 images were retained for each view for 581 patients.
blocks.zh: FLARE2023 (法语) Dataset Ma等人(2024年):从3D腹腔CT卷中提取了2D片,上面有两处观点的肝脏说明. 根据肝脏大小和肿瘤的存在进行过滤后,为581名患者保留了581幅图像。

blocks.en: MSD Dataset Simpson et al. (2019) : We extracted 2D sections with dual views labeled for the anterior hippocampus. After image quality screening, 172 images were retained for each view for 172 patients.
blocks.zh: MSD 服务器 Dataset Simpson 等人 (2019年): (英语). 我们提取了2D部分 上面标有两面视图 上面标注了前河马营 在图像质量筛选后,为172名患者保留了172幅图像。

blocks.en: To distinguish between the two views, the results are uniformly labeled as the “long-axis view” and the “short-axis view.” All datasets were split at the patient level to prevent data leaks. First, 20% of the data was selected as an independent test set (not used for training), and the remaining data was subjected to five-fold cross-validation. All datasets underwent a standardized preprocessing workflow. For each dataset, images were cropped to a size of 512×512 pixels. During training, data augmentation was applied only to the training set to improve the model’s generalization ability. Neither the validation set nor the test set underwent data augmentation to ensure the objectivity and consistency of the evaluation.
blocks.zh: 为了区分两种观点,结果统一标注为"长轴视图"和"短轴视图". 所有数据集在患者一级被分割,以防止数据泄露. 一,20%的数据被选为独立测试集(未用于培训),其余数据经过五倍的交叉验证. 所有数据集都经过了标准化的预处理工作流程。 对于每个数据集,图像被裁剪到512x512像素大小. 在培训期间,数据扩增只适用于培训组,以提高模型的普及能力。 验证组和测试组都没有增加数据,以确保评价的客观性和一致性。

blocks.en: 4.2 Evaluation Metrics
blocks.zh: 4.2 评价计量

blocks.en: We adopted four commonly used evaluation metrics in medical image segmentation: The Dice similarity coefficient(DSC), which measures the degree of overlap between the segmentation results and the gold standard. The Jaccard index (IoU), which is the ratio of the intersection to the union. The 95% Hausdorff distance (HD95), which measures the degree of alignment of the segmentation boundaries. The average surface distance (ASD), which is the average distance between points on the segmentation boundaries. Using 5-fold cross-validation, we identified five optimal models, tested them on the independent test set, and reported the average values of the aforementioned metrics.

blocks.en: 5 Results
blocks.zh: 5 结果

blocks.en: 5.1 Comparison with Single-Path Segmentation Models
blocks.zh: 5.1 与单平面分割模型的比较

blocks.en: To validate the DPIF’s generality and its advantages in few-shot scenarios, we selected 24 representative encoder-decoder networks as single-path (SP) baseline models and constructed corresponding dual-path (DP) variants by integrating the DPIF framework. All models were trained and evaluated on three multi-view datasets. The complete quantitative results are shown in TABLE 1 to TABLE 3 and Fig 3 . Experimental results show that all dual-path variants achieved performance improvements on the three datasets. In terms of the DSC metric, the dual-path variants achieved an average improvement of 13.33% on the long-axis views and 8.97% on the short-axis views across the three datasets. Notably, the hippocampus long-axis dataset showed the largest average DSC improvement, reaching 19.2%. Among these, RollingUNet demonstrated the most significant improvement, with a 57.57% increase in DSC on the hippocampus long-axis dataset. This confirms that DPIF can effectively leverage the complementary anatomical information inherent in both views without introducing directional performance bias. Regarding boundary accuracy metrics, the average HD95 decreased by 4.27 in the long-axis view and by 2.38 in the short-axis view across the three datasets. It is worth noting that a few models (such as SCSEUNet) showed a slight decrease in HD95. Nevertheless, the overall trend confirms that DPIF effectively enhances the boundary continuity and anatomical fidelity of segmentation results for most architectures, delivering stable and consistent performance improvements across a variety of segmentation network architectures.

blocks.en: 5.2 Comparison with Multi-View Segmentation Methods
blocks.zh: 5.2 与多视频分区比较 方法

blocks.en: We selected five representative multi-view medical image segmentation methods for comparison. To ensure fairness in the experiments, all comparison methods used the same UMNet as the backbone network, were trained on exactly the same data split. The quantitative results are shown in TABLE 4 . Fig 4 visualizes the percentage improvement for all methods. It can be seen that the DPIF framework demonstrates a consistent performance advantage across all views on the three datasets. In particular, on the long-axis view of the liver dataset, DP-UMNet achieves a 5.77% improvement over the single-path baseline, significantly outperforming all comparison methods. In contrast, on all three test datasets, all other methods underperform DP-UMNet. Most of these methods even performed worse than the single-path UMNet baseline model, with only a few achieving a slight improvement on the liver dataset. Among them, MSMVNet and CoBioNet exhibited the most significant performance declines. Overall, compared to existing multi-view segmentation methods, the DPIF framework achieves stable and consistent performance improvements in multi-view tasks spanning different imaging modalities and anatomical structures.

blocks.en: 5.3 Ablation Studies and Analyses
blocks.zh: 5.3 研究与分析

blocks.en: To quantitatively verify individual contributions and synergies among DPIF components, we perform progressive ablation experiments on the multicenter PME echocardiography dataset with UMNet as the backbone. Taking single‑path UMNet as baseline, nine ablation variants are built to evaluate four modules: two‑layer feature decoupling (A), Sinkhorn unpaired distribution alignment (B), adaptive interaction weights (C), and cross‑view topological consistency regularization (D). Quantitative results are reported in TABLE 5 . The results show that decoupling features across two layers yields only a slight improvement, as it achieves feature separation and noise suppression within branches but does not facilitate cross-view information exchange. Sinkhorn-based distribution alignment is the primary driver of performance improvement, increasing DSC by 2% for the long-axis view and 2.24% for the short-axis view, respectively. This validates that distribution-level semantic matching is the primary channel for cross-view knowledge transfer. When used alone, adaptive interaction weights yielded a negligible improvement, indicating that dynamic weighting cannot function effectively without the support of distribution alignment. Cross-view topological regularization independently optimized segmentation boundaries, increasing the long-axis DSC by 1.14% and reducing HD95 by approximately 0.39.

blocks.en: 5.4 Analysis of Different Training Data Usage
blocks.zh: 5.4 不同培训数据的使用情况分析

blocks.en:
To investigate the performance and few-shot adaptability of DPIF under different levels of data usage, we conducted gradient data experiments on three multi-view datasets using three representative backbone networks (RollingUNet, UNet and UMNet). Among these, RollingUNet represents a class of networks with poor baseline performance, UNet represents a class of classic segmentation networks, and UMNet represents a class of networks with superior baseline performance.
We employed a stratified inclusive sampling method, stratified by multicenter origin and lesion proportion, to construct training subsets of 20%, 40%, 60%, and 80%. Smaller subsets were fully nested within larger ones to isolate data volume as the sole variable while preserving the statistical distribution of the full dataset. All experiments used a fixed test set and five-fold cross-validation. The corresponding performance curves are illustrated in Fig 5 . The results show that the performance of the dual-path model increases monotonically as the amount of training data increases. The performance improvement is most significant in the range from 20% to 40%. In most cases, the DPIF-enhanced model can achieve the same accuracy as the full-data single-path model even when the annotation rate is below 60For weaker backbone networks, DPIF delivers greater performance improvements. DP-RollingUNet, trained on only 20% of the labeled data, outperformed the full-data single-path baseline model on the PME short-axis view. Cross-modal analysis indicates that the benefits of few-shot learning are positively correlated with task difficulty. In the PME echocardiography task, DP-UMNet outperforms full-data single-path models with a 60% annotation rate. On the high-contrast FLARE2023 liver CT dataset, it requires only 40% annotated data. On a high-resolution hippocampal MRI dataset, DP-UMNet requires a 60% annotation rate to approach the performance of the full-data single-path model.

blocks.en: 5.5 Blind Review of Segmentation Results by Clinicians
blocks.zh: 5.5 临床医生对分化结果的盲人审查

blocks.en: To verify whether the improvements achieved through dual-pathway interaction could translate into clinically usable segmentation results, we conducted a blinded review study across three datasets. Three ultrasound specialists and three radiology specialists evaluated the segmentation results using a 1–5-point Likert scale for 30 randomly selected cases from each view. For each case, the original image and the segmentation results from both DP-UMNet and SP-UMNet were displayed simultaneously, with the positions of the results randomized to avoid subjective bias. The results are shown in Table 6 . The advantages of DP-UMNet were most pronounced in the sections with the weakest baseline performance: in the PME short-axis section, DP-UMNet raised the average score to 3.49 ± 0.60, and the proportion of cases with a score of ≥ \geq 4 increased from 24.4% to 52.2%. In cases where single-path baseline models had already achieved high clinical scores (e.g., FLARE2023 short-axis and MSD short-axis), the dual-path enhancement did not yield further significant improvements. The inter-reader consistency (ICC) across views ranged from moderate to high. These results confirm that the introduction of DPIF not only improves the agreement between segmentation results and ground-truth labels but also demonstrates that DPIF achieves consistent clinical validation.

blocks.en: 6 Discussion
blocks.zh: 讨论

blocks.en: In the comparative experiment, traditional multi-view methods cannot guarantee consistent performance improvements and sometimes even underperform compared to single-view baseline models, particularly on noisier, unpaired data. Thanks to its multiple functional modules—particularly feature alignment and two-layer decoupling, DPIF mitigates the effects of noise and differences in interaction targets. As a result, it continues to demonstrate performance improvements even on challenging datasets such as ultrasound and MRI.
blocks.zh: 在比较实验中,传统的多视图方法不能保证一致的性能改善,有时甚至比单视图基线模型表现不佳,特别是在鼻音,无孔数据上. 由于其多个功能模块——特别是特征对齐和双层脱钩,DPIF减轻了噪音和相互作用目标差异的影响. 因此,即使在超声波和核磁共振等具有挑战性的数据集上,它也继续表现出性能的改善.

blocks.en: Gradient data experiments confirm that DPIF improves data utilization efficiency. The magnitude of performance improvement increases as task difficulty and baseline model performance decrease. For low-performance backbone networks such as RollingUNet, DPIF delivers significant improvements, indicating its immense potential in the field of rare diseases where annotations are scarce. Notably, performance continues to improve steadily even when the data usage is 100%. Therefore, DPIF serves not only as a solution for few-shot learning but also as a general-purpose enhancement module for fully supervised multi-view clinical pipelines.
blocks.zh: 渐变数据实验证实DPIF提高了数据利用率. 随着任务困难和基线模型性能下降,业绩改进的程度也随之增加。 对于诸如RollingUNet这样的低效骨干网络,新闻部提供重大改进,表明其在缺乏说明的罕见疾病领域的巨大潜力。 值得注意的是,即使数据使用率为100%,业绩也继续稳步改善。 因此,DPIF不仅作为几发学习的解决方案,而且作为全监督的多景临床管道的通用增强模块.

blocks.en: Nevertheless, the framework presented in this paper has some limitations. The current implementation supports only two-view interactions, extending it to three or more views would facilitate the volumetric segmentation of 3D data. Topological regularization employs a differentiable persistent homology approximation, which may overlook subtle topological features. Therefore, a more precise differentiable topological solver is needed.
blocks.zh: 然而,本文件提出的框架有一些局限性。 目前的执行只支持双视图互动,将其扩展至三个或三个以上视图将有助于三维数据的量分化。 地形正规化采用不同的持续同源近似法,这可能忽略了微妙的地形特征。 因此,需要一个更精确的、不同的地形解析器。

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en: This paper proposes a general-purpose, plug-and-play dual-path interaction framework called DPIF for multi-view medical image segmentation, which improved data utilization when data is limited. DPIF achieves consistent performance improvements across 24 encoder-decoder backbone networks and outperforms existing multi-view segmentation methods. It can match or exceed the performance of single-path models trained on the full dataset using only a subset of data of a certain size. This demonstrates that DPIF provides a practical and scalable solution for multi-view medical image segmentation under data-scarce conditions.
blocks.zh: 本文提出一个通用的,插件和播放的双路径交互框架,称为DPIF,用于多视图医学影像分解,在数据有限时可以提高数据的利用率. DPIF在24个编码器-解码器主干网中实现了一致的性能改进,并且超越了现有的多视图分割方法. 它能够匹配或超过在完整数据集上训练的单路径模型的性能,只使用一定大小的子集数据. 这表明DPIF为多视图医学图像在数据稀缺条件下的分解提供了实用和可扩展的解决方案.
